name: Sabrina Device
source:
Sabrina is a witch who was born into a small European village a century ago. She's a bit old-fashioned and has trouble keeping up with modern trends. She used to be a shy, retiring kind of girl, but Sabrina's determined to show off a brand new side of herself at the Halloween Party... if only she can figure out how to get there!

[From Winged Cloud]
